note: Functional evidence coverage (which behaviours/stages have mapped automated evidence), NOT line/branch code coverage. Derived: never edit by hand.

rules.ok: at least one DIRECT test with PASS and no failing direct test
rules.stale: direct tests exist but their PASS evidence is stale
rules.partial: only indirect evidence, or direct tests that are not (yet) PASS, or a failing direct test
rules.strength: best strength among direct tests with PASS/STALE evidence (indirect evidence is capped at LIMITED); NONE_MAPPED if nothing is mapped
